newsitem.title: USA: Light earthquakes shake northern California.
newsitem.headline: Light earthquakes shake northern California.

text.p: A series of light earthquakes shook northern California early on Thursday, waking up some residents but there were no reports of injuries or damage.
The largest of the quakes, measuring 3.5 on the Richter scale, struck at 7:39 a.m. PST, and was centred close to Pittsburg, about 35 miles northeast of San Francisco.
More than a dozen light earthquakes, ranging from 2.1 to 3.5 on the Richter scale, were recorded in the area over 24 hours from Wednesday morning.
"These are all very minor earthquakes," said Susan Garcia, a spokeswoman for the U.S. Geological Survey in Menlo Park, California. "The sequence is not unusual."
